title: Change order extraction result
description: One change order extracted from one document. Every field is an object with exactly `value` and `confidence`. A value the document does not state, or that could not be established, is null with confidence 0. Confidence is a band label (0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.97), not a calibrated probability.

project_name.description: Name of the construction project, as written in the document.

contract_number.description: Identifier of the original contract that the change order modifies.

date.description: Date of the change order itself, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when the document gives none or when day and month cannot be told apart.

requested_by.description: Person or organisation that requested the change.

description.description: The document's own wording of the change in the work.

amount.description: Signed change to the contract value in the document's own currency: positive for an increase, negative for a decrease or credit, 0 when the document states the price does not change. Never the original or revised contract total.

schedule_impact_days.description: Signed change to the contract time in days: positive for an extension, negative for a reduction, 0 when the document states the schedule does not change, null when it does not say.

approval_status.description: Normalised approval state. Null when the document does not establish one.

needs_review.description: True when a person should check this result before it is used.

value.description: approved: the approving party approved or executed it. rejected: it was rejected, denied or declined. pending: it awaits a decision, review or signature. draft: it is marked as a draft or not for execution. void: it was voided, cancelled, withdrawn or superseded.
